claim_boundary: Development selection of a minimal feedback-generation repair only; not confirmation, universal superiority, formula-recovery attribution, acquisition efficacy, or optimization success.

selected_intervention.name: protected_blind_exploration_floor
selected_intervention.reason: Hard abstention explains candidate-pool losses but not admitted-bank losses; generated-but-lower-value gap-conditioned proposals explain the strongest final-bank loss. A protected blind slot addresses both without changing Bayesian diagnosis or independent admission.
required_behavior: Keep the current posterior-gap computation unchanged.
Keep independent admission, prior, posterior update and thresholds unchanged.
Keep total materialized candidate slots per island and round equal to the original D maximum.
Reserve at least one candidate slot per island and round whose generation context contains no posterior-gap brief or gap-derived stop decision.
Use the remaining registered slot for gap-directed generation only when propose_allowed is true.
When propose_allowed is false, retain the protected blind slot; the gap-directed slot may abstain.
Record context identity and candidate lineage separately for blind and gap-directed slots.
Do not allow cross-slot memory, candidate copying or hidden gap information in the blind slot.
explicitly_forbidden_changes: result-dependent retries, seeds or stopping rules

comparators.D_original: gap exposed to generation plus independent admission/update
comparators.C_context_control: gap masked from generation plus independent admission/update
comparators.R_exploration_floor: original D plus the protected blind exploration slot under the same materialized-candidate ceiling

requirements: pysr import succeeds in the exact child interpreter
JuliaCall project and Julia executable identities are recorded
a response-free synthetic PySR fit returns at least one finite expression
all three arms resolve the identical engine schedule

primary_estimand.name: final_admitted_bank_independent_reporting_log_score
primary_estimand.reporting_rule: responses open only after all generation/admission artifacts freeze
primary_estimand.task_aggregation: mean over seeds within task, equal mean across tasks
primary_estimand.development_selection_rule: R-minus-D lower interval bound > 0 and R-minus-C lower interval bound >= 0

secondary_diagnostics: proposal count by blind versus gap-directed lineage
provider attempts, tokens and wall time

confirmation_boundary.next_action: identify and register a new untouched equation family or dataset before confirmation
